new_core_claims: Time-stamped DTM tiles are EA raster elevation data.
DTM removes surface objects from DSM using automated and manual processing.
DTM tiles are supplied as GeoTIFF rasters in 5 km zip files.
DTM elevations are in metres and referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn.
Time-stamped DTM data is aligned to the OS Grid.
Metadata catalogues record survey dates, resolution, transformation and geoidal model.
Time-stamped DSM retains surface objects unlike DTM.
Point clouds contain x, y and z points plus component attributes.
EA gridded DSM and DTM products are derived from point clouds.
Point-cloud coverage metadata records flight dates and average point density.
Composite DTM merges time-stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys.
Composite DTM is resampled to improve coverage.
The 2 m composite DTM is supplied in 5 km OS-grid-aligned GeoTIFF tiles.
The 2 m catalogue advertises WFS metadata and WCS coverage services.
The 10 m composite DTM is supplied as a single OS-grid-aligned GeoTIFF.
Ground-truth surveys independently verify time-stamped LIDAR accuracy.
Ground-truth points have stated accuracy of plus or minus 3 cm RMSE.
Ground-truth attributes include date, surface type, method, transformation and geoidal model.
Composite DSM 1 m also advertises GeoTIFF, WFS and WCS resources.
DTM and DSM must not be interchanged because they model different surfaces.
revalidated_core_claims: Catalogue WCS availability does not prove candidate-specific numeric response bytes.
Survey-date metadata is required when multiple observations cover a location.
Resolution metadata is required before comparing products.
Vertical datum and geoidal transformation are required for cross-source height comparison.
TQ2892 requires exact filtered service or tile readback before promotion.
Ground-truth accuracy does not transfer automatically to every raster cell.
An advertised endpoint is not equivalent to verified response bytes or values.
Numeric height-difference promotion remains blocked until exact candidate cells and lineage are read.
